query:
SELECT EXISTS (
                 SELECT 1 FROM projects.locations l
                   JOIN projects.projects p ON p.id = l.project_id
                  WHERE l.machine_uuid = $1
                    AND NOT starts_with(p.project_path, 'machine:')
                    AND starts_with(l.root_path || '/', rtrim($2, '/') || '/')
               ) AS "held!"
